0.4.23 bounded source fix for Linux IPC path length, 2026-10-18.

Installed vLLM0.14 source read through Ubuntu UNC, without imports:
- envs.py:543-545 reads VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH, falling back to tempfile.gettempdir().
- utils/network_utils.py:141-143 returns ipc://<base>/<uuid4()>.
The actual socket filesystem name therefore appends one slash plus a 36-character UUID. Linux sockaddr_un permits 107 path bytes plus its terminating NUL. The supervisor records and rejects an overlong computed path before loading any model. With normal mkdtemp's 8-character suffix, /tmp/xt-XXXXXXXX/<UUID> is 53 bytes.

linux_supervisor.py creates a unique Linux /tmp directory with tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='xt-',dir='/tmp'), mode0700. It stores a private marker and status identity: run token, path, filesystem device/inode, UID, supervisor PID; creation time and socket-length arithmetic are in status. A redirected /tmp root is refused. TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP/VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH all use that short directory, applied after inherited/per-service environment values to both the owned header helper and all model/backend service children. No Windows-mounted profile/evidence path supplies IPC/temp storage. xt_services.py no longer creates or selects profile/xt-services/<token>/tmp. Immutable logs, manifests, status and model evidence retain their original locations.

Both normal supervisor shutdown and explicit targeted --cleanup first confirm owned processes and GPU allocations are gone. Only then does cleanup verify the exact /tmp/xt-* path, nonsymlink status, recorded device/inode/UID, private mode and matching owner marker before symlink-resistant shutil.rmtree. If process/GPU cleanup is unconfirmed, or directory identity/removal is uncertain, the directory is preserved and cleanup is not reported confirmed. Recovery retains the earlier status/short-temp ownership record. No distro termination or broad temporary-directory deletion.

Changed implementation only: relay/xt_services.py and vendor/linux_supervisor.py. Source baselines and P13-short-linux-temp.patch are saved. Model choices, ports, deadlines, GPU budget/floor and controller are unchanged.
Evidence is source inspection/diff/hashes only. No tests, imports, compilation, applications, servers or model runs. Actual IPC startup remains unverified pending a separately authorized run; no rerun was attempted.

r64 addendum: admission requires socket path bytes +16-byte safety margin strictly less than107; failure is structured fatal xt_ipc_path_too_long, propagated unchanged by XTServices. Owner marker explicitly names kevflix-xtranslator. Intentional ownership containment relative to Claude's startup-sweep suggestion: no sweep/delete of other /tmp directories is implemented. Explicit recovery cleans only the same manifest/status run-token record after process/GPU confirmation, protecting disjoint sessions.
Installed-tree source scan found only two literal ipc:// locations: network_utils.py:143 generates paths, and distributed/kv_events.py:364 accepts a configured optional KV-event endpoint. The latter is not enabled by this launcher (config/kv_events.py:18 defaults false; endpoint defaults TCP, replay None). Actual generated IPC callers v1/utils.py:154, v1/engine/utils.py:890, and distributed/device_communicators/shm_broadcast.py:308 all use get_open_zmq_ipc_path and therefore the short VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH. The sole AF_UNIX API-listener helper in entrypoints/openai/api_server.py is selected only for an explicit --uds; this launcher uses host127.0.0.1/port and supplies no --uds. No additional Unix-socket route was activated or changed.
